Subject: Invoice query — split for EU/UK services

Hi Diego,

We received the November invoice for the Redwood platform. Our AP team is asking whether you can split the invoice into two lines: one for the EU-hosted services (EUR) and one for the UK-hosted services (GBP). They need this to route payments through different GLs and to apply the correct VAT handling for our EU subsidiaries.

Specifically, we need:
- Separate invoice lines with clear currency and amounts
- Copy of Redwood's VAT registration for EU services or confirmation you will apply reverse-charge where applicable
- Bank details for EUR settlement (SEPA)

Can you confirm if Redwood can provide a split invoice and the VAT residency proof? We need to process payment by 2026-11-18 to avoid a vendor hold.

Thanks,
Procurement Team
GreenWave Telecom

Hi Procurement team — thanks for the note and the heads up on the payment window.

We can absolutely issue a split invoice. A couple of quick clarifications so we get this right: 
- Are the EU-hosted services the ones consumed by your German and Netherlands subsidiaries (GL codes you provided earlier)?
- For the EU line, do you want Redwood to show VAT as zero with a "reverse-charge" note, or would you prefer we include our EU VAT number on that line and let you reclaim per local rules?
- For the UK line (GBP), we will include VAT if applicable unless you confirm we're billing a UK-registered business entity that expects reverse-charge.

I'll loop in Laura (account lead) to coordinate the invoice format. Marcus from finance will confirm the VAT residency docs we can provide. If you can send a single contact name for AP (and the exact GL codes), we can generate the revised invoice and send the SEPA banking details.

Best,
